name: How long does a typical home addition project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical home addition project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a home addition project varies significantly based on its size, complexity, and the specific permitting requirements of your city (e.g., Pacifica, Daly City). Generally, a smaller addition might take 3-6 months from design to completion, while a larger, more complex project, like a second-story addition or a significant expansion, could take 8-12 months or longer. This includes time for architectural design, securing permits, material procurement, and construction. Unexpected site conditions or design changes can also influence the schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical home addition can take 3-12 months or more, depending on its size, complexity, and local permitting processes. This includes design, permits, and construction.
